about: Scripts in tools/tests/ that a plain full run cannot judge. tools/validation/run_test_suite.py skips the listed groups by default and reports them apart, so a failure outside them is new drift. Remove a script from a group as soon as it is ported, or delete it if it has no openPR06 subject. Every other script must pass when run bare from the repository root.

deferred-release-lane.reason: Inherited openQ4 macOS, Linux ARM64, packaging and release-lane fixtures. They pin the DISABLED openQ4 workflows, openQ4 package names, split game-sp/game-mp modules or openQ4 evidence documents. They are kept for the lane rebuild tracked as TODO-RELEASE-LANES in docs/dev/prey-rebase/status-ledger.md, and are not openPR06 checks until then.

pending-source-port.reason: The subject exists in openPR06, but the source still lacks the upstream openQ4 change the test checks, so the test is right to fail. generated_animation_cache and level_load_cache: src/game/anim/Anim.cpp is on generated-animation cache version 1 and lacks openQ4's version 3 validation (CRC trailer, finite and bounded values, staged writes, the level-load animation resource).

needs-arguments.reason: Build helpers and harness drivers that Meson or a person runs with arguments; run bare they print their usage.

needs-runtime.reason: Runtime checks that need a staged .install or builddir, retail Prey assets, a device or emulator, or another host platform. Run them by hand against a build (see each script's --help).

slow.about: Mutation-heavy scripts that need longer than the default per-script limit, in seconds. They are run, not skipped.
